title: KS2 summary
description: One row per school of the supplier's KS2 school summary file, transcribed from the KS2 Summary data share specification. One schema serves the September and December files (x-csv.columns 'september' and 'december'): the December file adds the four disadvantaged pupil fields at the end, which are not in the September file. Field references are the CSV headers. Values are strings, because a suppressed value is sent as 'NA' or '+'.
